safety_guard: requires session-local app.schema_snapshot_replay=ci-empty-replay on the isolated CI connection; it is never persisted at database scope
refuses any existing relation, routine, or user-defined type in the four application schemas before DDL

replay_validation.database: fresh local Supabase Postgres only; no linked or remote database
replay_validation.replay_principal: Connect to the validated loopback endpoint as the pinned stack's built-in supabase_admin login and verify its superuser identity. Each temporary migration dynamically executes session-local SET ROLE NONE inside one DO block, then asserts the effective supabase_admin superuser before application DDL; this avoids the pinned CLI's top-level role-reset reassertion. Query-level connection overrides are discarded; CI does not grant, revoke, or create roles or change persistent role settings.
replay_validation.execution_evidence: This manifest records the pinned replay procedure only; record the exact commit and CI result in the external audit report after a passing run.

scope_exclusions: No SQL was written to the sandbox source project or production.
No seed/application data, credentials, API keys, or custom operational roles were captured.
No production deployment or Vercel configuration change was made.
No build, test, database service, or instrumentation was run on the user's Mac.
